user_query: Which box on the payroll FAQ lists the student FICA exemption, and who do I contact if withholding looks wrong?

Payroll FAQ — Enrolled students who also work on campus are FICA-exempt in Box 12 of the FAQ. If a paycheck withholding looks wrong, contact Payroll Services at payroll@campus.example (helpdesk only; they will not collect personal identifiers through an assistant).
